# Test the bundled Steps, Accordion, Frame, and Columns components.

md2html -html output -html-ext html testsite
exists output/README.html

# Steps render as a real ordered list, so numbering is the browser's job
# and an explicit stepNumber is just the li value attribute.
grep '<ol class="md-steps" data-title-size="h3">' output/README.html
grep '<li class="md-step">' output/README.html
grep '<li class="md-step" value="7">' output/README.html
grep '<div class="md-step-title">Install</div>' output/README.html
grep '<code>go install</code>' output/README.html

# Accordions are details elements, so expanding needs no JavaScript.
grep '<details class="md-accordion" open>' output/README.html
grep '<summary class="md-accordion-summary">' output/README.html
grep '<span class="md-accordion-description">the reason</span>' output/README.html

# A false defaultOpen stays closed rather than being read as a non-empty
# string.
! grep '<details class="md-accordion" id="closed" open>' output/README.html

# Expandable is the same disclosure under its other name.
grep 'child fields' output/README.html

# Frames caption above and below.
grep '<div class="md-frame-hint">Figure 1</div>' output/README.html
grep '<figcaption class="md-frame-caption">A diagram</figcaption>' output/README.html

# Columns is an accepted spelling of CardGroup.
grep '<div class="md-card-group" data-cols="4">' output/README.html

# Styles for the new components ship with the page.
grep '\.md-steps ' output/README.html
grep '\.md-accordion ' output/README.html
grep '\.md-frame ' output/README.html

rm -rf testsite output

-- testsite/README.md --
# Components

<Steps titleSize="h3">

<Step title="Install">
Run `go install`.
</Step>

<Step title="Later" stepNumber="7">
then this
</Step>

</Steps>

<AccordionGroup>

<Accordion title="Why" description="the reason" defaultOpen={true}>
Because.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="Closed" id="closed" defaultOpen="false">
Hidden.
</Accordion>

</AccordionGroup>

<Expandable title="child fields">
Nested detail.
</Expandable>

<Frame caption="A diagram" hint="Figure 1">
![alt](x.png)
</Frame>

<Columns cols={4}>

<Card title="One">
first
</Card>

</Columns>
